rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for drinks or other things that contain alcohol.

example.english: This drink is alcoholic; don't let children drink it.
example.traditional: 呢杯飲品係有酒精嘅，唔好畀細路飲。
example.jyutping: ni1 bui1 jam2 ban2 hai6 jau5 zau2 zing1 ge3 m4 hou2 bei2 sai3 lou6 jam2

rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial term for a person addicted to alcohol.

example.english: He gets drunk every day—he's a real alcoholic.
example.traditional: 佢日日飲到醉，真係個酒鬼。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jat6 jat6 jam2 dou3 zeoi3 zan1 hai6 go3 zau2 gwai2

rows.note: Use this written or formal term when describing an alcohol-dependent person in more official language.

example.english: The report states that the alcoholic needs treatment for alcohol dependence.
example.traditional: 報告指出，該名酗酒者需要接受戒酒治療。
example.jyutping: bou3 gou3 zi2 ceot1 goi1 ming4 heoi3 zau2 ze2 seoi1 jiu3 zip3 sau6 gaai3 zau2 zi6 liu4
